children: The U.A.E.'s non-oil private sector expanded at its strongest pace since December 2024 in August, with the S&P Global Purchasing Managers' Index rising to 55.3 from 52.7 in July. New business and output growth accelerated sharply as activity recovered from earlier conflict-related disruption. Dubai's PMI also strengthened, rising to 54.1 from 51.7. The readings point to renewed momentum in the U.A.E.'s non-oil economy after the slowdown earlier in the summer, S&P Global says. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
